meta.title: rs project agent-swarm speedrun: attempts timeline
meta.timezone: All times UTC. PDT = UTC-7. Times printed inside messages (e.g. main's '(PDT)' or '(xx:xxZ)' stamps) were often drifted; the timestamp used here is the message's stored created_at.
meta.IMPORTANT_data_caveat: attempts-window-msgs.jsonl's 'ts' field is Pacific local time with a misleading 'Z' suffix (e.g. ts 2026-10-23T09:01:46Z = created_at 1792771306 = 16:01:46Z). The DuckDB recipe strftime(to_timestamp(x),...) renders local time on this Mac and reproduces the same 7-hour shift. This timeline converts created_at epochs to UTC in Python.

source_conventions.messages: uri = the sender's messages collection; msg_id = DuckDB messages.id in rs-20261026.duckdb (some recorded as an 8-hex prefix)
source_conventions.rs843: cairn://p/rs/843 comment number; ts_as_printed is the comment's PDT stamp
source_conventions.operator: operator messages are DuckDB events with event_type='user' on the named thread's run; quoted verbatim

meta.naming: Scored account names are withheld (the swarm's rule: 'SCORED'). Fleet helper names (cairn_b03 etc.) are kept where they are part of a verbatim cause.
meta.tick_units: Scored playtime is logged-in ticks; logged-out wall time is free on the record. The official score is normalized to 400 ms ticks.
